title: Merge Sorted Array
goal: Solve Merge Sorted Array: Merge from the largest ends into the spare tail of the first array so unread values are not overwritten.
strategy: Merge from the largest ends into the spare tail of the first array so unread values are not overwritten.
edgeCases: If the second array still has values, copy them; leftover first-array values are already in place.
inputRules: Use {nums1, m, nums2, n}; nums1 must have m+n slots and nums2 must have n items.
